_note: Owner: member 3. Tag names are lowercase and singular and may contain spaces. model_label_map translates detector labels to tags, matched case-insensitively; any label not in it is dropped. v2 (28 Oct): Rekognition label names confirmed from a 30-image pilot (tools/testset). Frog, Amphibian, Hare, Canine, Coyote and Wolf are left out on purpose because they also fire on lookalikes (tree frogs, hares, foxes vs dogs). lost_pet_colours (31 Oct) are the colours a lost pet sighting can have: tagging picks one per crop, and the Lex bot uses the same list as a slot type. Adding them leaves version at 2, because version tracks the label map that config/model's thresholds were chosen for.
